parole.significato: A whip or strap about a yard in length.
parole.testo: From Arabic كُرْبَاج (kurbāj), from Turkish kırbaç. Compare French cravache and German Karbatsche. Doublet of cravache.

parole.significato: A fountain, a small structure in a Muslim area where water is freely dispensed to members of the public.
parole.testo: From Arabic سبيل (sabīl) or Turkish sebil.
